ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Full Extent of Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the child care fraud scandal in Minnesota, including the allegations of fake daycare centers and misuse of funds. It would also examine the government's response to the situation and the potential impact on vulnerable families.
questions: What is the full extent of the child care fraud in Minnesota?
How has the government responded to the situation?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. It requires a thorough investigation and analysis of the situation, including a review of government documents and interviews with key stakeholders.
